description: Prompt manifest for Goal Digger content pipeline. Backend Agent: use these files as the source of truth when embedding prompts into Edge Functions.

news-generator.description: Generates news content items from raw football data. Decides newsworthiness and creates headline, body, and talking points.
news-generator.trigger: Called by content-generator Edge Function when data-fetcher finds new data

decision_logic.publish_if: is_newsworthy === true AND newsworthiness_score >= 6 AND headline.length <= 200 AND talking_points.length >= 3 AND talking_points.length <= 5

matchday-generator.description: Generates matchday briefing content ~90 minutes before kickoff. Always published (not subject to newsworthiness filter).
matchday-generator.trigger: Called by matchday-scheduler Edge Function on game days
matchday-generator.notes: Matchday content is always generated and published. The if_they_win, if_they_lose, and bold_prediction fields are stored in content_items.talking_points JSONB but displayed in the Post-Match Cheat Sheet section of ContentDetailView.

review-bot-tone.description: Review Bot 1: Checks content tone, voice, jargon usage, condescension, and conversational framing.
review-bot-tone.trigger: Called by content-reviewer Edge Function after content is generated

review-bot-accuracy.description: Review Bot 2: Cross-references every factual claim against raw source data.
review-bot-accuracy.trigger: Called by content-reviewer Edge Function after content is generated (in parallel with tone and brevity bots)
review-bot-accuracy.pass_criteria: pass === true (auto-fail on any critical error, fail on >2 minor errors)

review-bot-brevity.description: Review Bot 3: Ensures content is concise, scannable, and respects length limits.
review-bot-brevity.trigger: Called by content-reviewer Edge Function after content is generated (in parallel with tone and accuracy bots)

review_pipeline.description: All 3 review bots run in parallel. Content must pass ALL 3 to be approved.
review_pipeline.approval_rule: ALL bots must return pass: true
review_pipeline.on_any_fail: Set content_items.status = 'rejected', store review notes in content_items.review_notes
